versions.changelog:
- Released initial version of A股每日短线复盘完整框架（030体系）
- Provides a seven-stage daily review workflow: trade review, pre-market scan, auction analysis, open validation, intraday strategy, closing data summary, and next-day scenario projection
- Includes quantitative standards for position management, signal conflict resolution, scenario simulation, and a daily log template
- Core principle: “风险第一” with strict stop-loss and capital preservation rules
- Designed for fast execution (most tasks under 10-30 minutes) and targeted at A股短线 traders
